meta.source: Klar UI/UX canvas (brand sheet, logo sheet, landing page, five app screens), September 2026

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Page ground under every screen. The four mesh tints sit on top of it so glass has something to blur.

tokens.name: mesh-blue
tokens.usage: Mesh light, top left of a page. Radial, about 760 × 560 px, fading to nothing at 62%.

tokens.name: mesh-peach
tokens.usage: Mesh light, top right of a page.

tokens.name: mesh-teal
tokens.usage: Mesh light, bottom centre of a page.

tokens.name: mesh-lilac
tokens.usage: Mesh light, bottom corner of a page. Use at most four mesh lights per page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and the wordmark. Also the ground of dark panels.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text: step decisions, facts, body text inside glass-thin.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, citations beside rows, helper lines. 6.2:1 on mist, 6.7:1 on glass.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Text and the wordmark on ink or on glass-dark.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Form fields, the pressed segment of a segmented control, the active sidebar item, document previews.

tokens.name: lens-blue
tokens.usage: The one brand colour: primary buttons, links, focus rings, selected states, the last step of anything.

tokens.name: lens-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Link text on hover.

tokens.name: lens-blue-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the primary button's liquid gradient.

tokens.name: lens-blue-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the primary button's liquid gradient.

tokens.name: lens-blue-light
tokens.usage: Top of the question-bubble gradient in chat and of Lens blue showcase tiles; the gradient ends in lens-blue.

tokens.name: lens-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Background of 'to fill in' markers in draft documents, with a dashed lens-blue border at 40%.

tokens.name: glass-top
tokens.usage: Start of the glass fill, at 150°. Pair with glass-bottom, blur-glass and saturate-glass.

tokens.name: glass-bottom
tokens.usage: End of the glass fill.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: 1 px border of every glass surface.

tokens.name: glass-thin
tokens.usage: Fill of glass-thin: chips, inner cards, segmented tracks. Never put body text on anything thinner.

tokens.name: glass-thin-rim
tokens.usage: 1 px border of glass-thin.

tokens.name: glass-dark-top
tokens.usage: Start of the dark glass fill: code panels, dark tiles. Text on it is paper.

tokens.name: glass-dark-bottom
tokens.usage: End of the dark glass fill.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside lists and tables.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Outline of neutral pills and evidence tags; field borders at 10%.

tokens.name: risk-prohibited
tokens.usage: Text of the Prohibited pill. Also destructive links (Delete my data).

tokens.name: risk-prohibited-dot
tokens.usage: Dot of the Prohibited pill.

tokens.name: risk-prohibited-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Prohibited pill, with a 1 px inset ring of the dot colour at 25%.

tokens.name: risk-high
tokens.usage: Text of the High-risk pill and the DRAFT stamp on documents.

tokens.name: risk-high-dot
tokens.usage: Dot of the High-risk pill; the dot beside the class on a result.

tokens.name: risk-high-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the High-risk pill.

tokens.name: risk-limited
tokens.usage: Text of the Limited risk pill.

tokens.name: risk-limited-dot
tokens.usage: Dot of the Limited risk pill.

tokens.name: risk-limited-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Limited risk pill.

tokens.name: risk-minimal
tokens.usage: Text of the Minimal risk pill and of done-step checks.

tokens.name: risk-minimal-dot
tokens.usage: Dot of the Minimal risk pill.

tokens.name: risk-minimal-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Minimal risk pill and of done-step circles (at 16%).

tokens.name: risk-out
tokens.usage: Text of the Out of scope pill.

tokens.name: risk-out-dot
tokens.usage: Dot of the Out of scope pill.

tokens.name: risk-out-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Out of scope pill.

tokens.name: status-ambiguous
tokens.usage: Text of the Legally ambiguous status pill.

tokens.name: status-ambiguous-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Legally ambiguous status pill.

tokens.name: logo-pale
tokens.usage: Pale band of the logo symbol in flat reproductions (print, Word, PDF).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Where does your AI tool stand under the AI Act?

styles.name: display-section
styles.sample: It checks in the Act's order, and shows its work.

styles.name: heading-page
styles.usage: The h1 of every app screen.

styles.name: heading-small
styles.usage: Headings of side panels and step cards.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Describe it in plain words, in English or German.
styles.usage: Landing hero lead and short intros.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Klar runs the Act's checks in their legal order.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Use the tool as the vendor's instructions say
styles.usage: List rows, table cells, panel text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons at small size, nav items, form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Citations beside rows, pills, helper text.

styles.name: micro
styles.sample: Guidance, not legal advice. Klar is an AI system.
styles.usage: The notice line at the foot of every screen. Never smaller.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: The risk class on a result. Klar's conclusion, in the wordmark's typeface: rounded and calm.

styles.name: verdict-small
styles.usage: The class on compact result cards, such as the landing page's hero.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Quoted provisions and drafted document body text.

styles.name: quote-small
styles.sample: … shall always be considered to be high-risk …
styles.usage: Quotes placed side by side in a step card.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: MCP and API examples on glass-dark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a pill or tag between dot and word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a pill and its neighbour; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; icon to label in nav items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards in a column; inner card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the main column and a side panel; between app sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page inset of the app (sidebar and main sit 24 px from the edges); card padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Padding of large glass cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between landing page columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Landing page section padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Outer padding of brand and logo sheets.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Evidence tags (Stated, Inferred, Assumed).

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text inputs, 'to fill in' markers.

tokens.name: radius-item
tokens.usage: Sidebar nav items.

tokens.name: radius-card-small
tokens.usage: Fact cards and other cards inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Small tiles, step cards in the reviewer view.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The standard glass card.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The sidebar and the result card.

tokens.name: radius-feature
tokens.usage: Large landing page panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, segmented controls, the nav bar.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface: top highlight, bottom rim, inner glow and a soft ink shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-thin
tokens.usage: glass-thin surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-dark
tokens.usage: glass-dark surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: The primary button: a liquid highlight on top, depth at the bottom and a blue glow.

tokens.name: shadow-button-ghost
tokens.usage: The ghost button.

tokens.name: shadow-item-active
tokens.usage: The active sidebar item and selected list items.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The pressed segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-highlight-high
tokens.usage: The one card that decided a High-risk result.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of glass and glass-dark.

tokens.name: blur-thin
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of glass-thin and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: saturate-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation of glass.

tokens.name: saturate-thin
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation of glass-thin; 150% on glass-dark.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Hover, exits and anything the user triggers: quick to start, settles softly. Nothing in Klar bounces.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: reveals, the hero sequence, the second half of the liquid switch.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Glint fade-in, card lift, shadow change.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Button lift and press.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: A section or card coming into view; headings come into focus over 1000 ms.

tokens.name: duration-exit
tokens.usage: A section leaving when you scroll back up: faster than its entrance, never staggered.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between cards arriving in order (the four checks, features, figures). 55 ms between app panels on load.

tokens.name: liquid-stretch
tokens.usage: First half of the liquid switch: the pill stretches to reach the new option.

tokens.name: liquid-settle
tokens.usage: Second half: the pill draws its tail in under the new option.

tokens.name: type-char
tokens.usage: Typewriter: time per character. 70 ms pause between lines; the caret blinks once a second at the end.

tokens.name: focus-blur
tokens.usage: Starting blur when a heading or verdict comes into focus; it sharpens to 0.

tokens.name: glint
tokens.usage: Centre of the light that follows the cursor on glass, fading out at 70% of a 220 px radius. 0.18 in the app.
